title: Example of the new bar: one shot with its line and the explainer layer
note: Not a finished video. One 3.5 s shot for the line about the sunlit ridges, with voice, subtitle and a short bed of music.

shots.job: This shot shows the orbiter whose laser altimeter mapped the pole's sunlight, over the pole itself, so the viewer understands where the fact about the sunlit ridges comes from.

lines.say: Some ridges at the south pole get sunlight most of the time.
